label: early original-phase steps 1-2 after p/k/2/r
explanation: Fires during the early original (input) phase, t=1..5 (peak at t=2, about 96% of mass in phase 0), on the one or two steps right after a p, k, 2 or r is input. It is strongest when that token was the immediate previous input (prev_tok p/k/2/r gives a 4-5x rate lift) and weaker two steps later. Top activations come from sequences that start with p p t. There is also weaker, sparser firing at other early steps (e.g. after t, 1, u) and at the delimiter step of short sequences. It is essentially silent at t=0, at t>=7, and during the copy phase (0.1% rate). It decays with position, so later inputs in long sequences do not trigger it. Dev F1 0.78, mass recall 0.92.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: p, k, 2, r, t, 1; least: v, c, x, e) and the input two steps back (most: p, k, 2, r, u, t; least: v, x, c, e); timing cues that raise it most: t=2, t=3, t=4.
